questions.question: In the state of Odisha, the festival of Jagannath Pooja is celebrated with great grandeur and is linked to which significant event?
What is the term for the condition in which water exists simultaneously in its solid, liquid, and gaseous states?
Who among the following won the 10th National Men's Snooker Championship 2025?
Which of the following Committees suggested the establishment of a District Development Commissioner at the District Level?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (GVK Rao Committee) है।

questions.question: 'Chapchar Kut' festival is primarily associated with which of the following states?
Which energy-storage innovation uses lifting and lowering heavy weights to store and release energy?

Air moves from the high-pressure area over the southern Indian Ocean in a south-easterly direction, crosses the equator and turns right towards the low-pressure areas over the Indian subcontinent. These are known as the ______________ Monsoon winds.
Under the PM Matsya Sampada Yojana, which of the following is the target for enhancing aquaculture productivity per hectare?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (From 3 tonnes to 5 tonnes) है।

questions.question: C-CARES portal, developed and designed by the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), is associated with which sector?
In July 2024, the Defence Ministry suspended all business dealings with which of the following companies for six months for involvement in the AgustaWestland VVIP helicopter case?
Which state government signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC) for green hydrogen and renewable energy development in January 2024?
How many gold medals did Tamil Nadu win at the Khelo India Youth Games 2025?
Which of the following are the coldest months in the northern part of India?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (December and January only) है।

questions.question: How does the PM Gati Shakti – National Master Plan aim to enhance infrastructure connectivity for more efficient project implementation?
options: By focusing solely on urban infrastructure development
By increasing the number of highways in rural areas
By establishing an integrated digital platform for inter-ministerial coordination
By developing new seaports exclusively for international trade
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (By establishing an integrated digital platform for inter-ministerial coordination) है।
